speaker: narrator
text: What if prices dropped *every minute* you waited?

speaker: narrator
text: Jay just inherited his grandma's toy shop. *Penny's*.

speaker: narrator
text: It's tiny. It's dusty. And it's *empty*.

speaker: bit
text: Rent is due Monday. *Nine thousand* dollars.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, I have *two hundred* dollars.

speaker: bit
text: Then we need Black Friday. And a *crazy idea*.

speaker: bit
text: Boston, nineteen oh nine. A store with *falling prices*.

speaker: bit
text: Unsold after twelve days? Twenty five percent *off*.

speaker: bit
text: Still unsold? It went to *charity*.

speaker: hero
text: Days are too slow. What about... *minutes*?

speaker: narrator
text: So they invent *the Drop*.

speaker: narrator
text: Mia, his best friend, prints *five hundred* flyers.

speaker: friend
text: Black Friday. Six a.m. Prices fall *till midnight*.

speaker: narrator
text: Friday morning, the line wraps around the *block*.

speaker: narrator
text: Six o'clock. The doors open. The clock *starts*.

speaker: narrator
text: Every price tag in the store starts *falling*.

speaker: hero
text: Okay, everyone. Go! *Buy things*!

speaker: narrator
text: But nobody moves. Not *one* person.

speaker: bit
text: Jay... they're not shopping. They're *waiting*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part two drops in two days.
